Its README documents a shared_preload_libraries background worker that can kill random sessions. Parent confirms source github.com/disco-stu/pg_rage_terminator is distinct from pg-crash.
PL/Perl language handler package; PG 18 payload includes plperl.so plus plperl/plperlu control and install SQL and language support libraries. No current CNPG image/backlog entry.

PL/Tcl language handler package; PG 18 payload includes pltcl.so plus pltcl/pltclu control and install SQL. No current CNPG image/backlog entry.

The PGDG package ships an external Perl Bucardo daemon plus /usr/share/bucardo/bucardo.schema. This SQL creates a dedicated Bucardo database/schema, PL/pgSQL/PL/PerlU setup, metadata tables, and trigger functions used by its asynchronous replication system. It is substantial server-side support (similar in kind to tracked Londiste SQL), rather than only arbitrary application tables, but not a CREATE EXTENSION package; installer creates a superuser/database and requires PL/PerlU. Review against immutable setup and operational/security requirements.
